title: Chronicle Weekly
description: Wednesday editions of the public event ledger, covering Thursday through Wednesday and dated the Wednesday each edition closes on. Only published editions are included; the set grows backwards over weekly runs. Index entries are newest first. Each article restates one ledger row. No facts are added.
undatedHandling: Only events with datePrecision=day are placed in a Thursday–Wednesday Wednesday edition. Events with month, quarter, or year precision are not assigned to a week. They appear in undatedByPeriod, grouped by the period the ledger already records, and are never given a fake week.

articles.headline: Residential energy storage sales begin
articles.body: Tesla began selling residential energy storage systems in 2013, per its Form 10-K for 2016. Commercial and utility systems followed in 2014; Powerwall 2 / Powerpack 2 production came later in Q4 2016.

sources.publisher: SEC, Tesla Form 10-K for year ended Dec. 31, 2016

articles.headline: Commercial and utility energy storage sales begin
articles.body: Tesla began selling commercial and utility energy storage systems in 2014 (after residential in 2013), covering backup power, peak demand reduction, and wholesale market services, per the 2016 Form 10-K.

sources.publisher: SEC, Tesla Form 10-K for year ended Dec. 31, 2016

undatedByPeriod.label: Q3 2015 (date not pinned to a day)

articles.headline: Tesla Energy Powerwall production and deliveries begin
articles.body: In Q3 2015 Tesla began production and deliveries of Powerwall (7/10 kWh) and Powerpack under the Tesla Energy brand, after the April 30, 2015 stage unveil. Gigafactory assembly of Tesla Energy products began in Q4 2015. Earlier home energy systems had been sold since 2013.

sources.publisher: SEC, Tesla Form 10-K for year ended Dec. 31, 2015

undatedByPeriod.label: Q4 2016 (date not pinned to a day)

articles.headline: Powerwall 2 and Powerpack 2 production begins
articles.body: In Q4 2016 Tesla began production and deliveries of Powerwall 2 (14 kWh) and Powerpack 2 (200 kWh blocks) at Gigafactory 1, with over-the-air update capability, per the 2016 Form 10-K.

sources.publisher: SEC, Tesla Form 10-K for year ended Dec. 31, 2016

undatedByPeriod.label: December 2017 (date not pinned to a day)

articles.headline: Solar Roof initial production at Gigafactory 2
articles.body: In December 2017 Tesla began manufacturing Solar Roof tiles (Textured and Smooth) at Gigafactory 2 in Buffalo; Tesla told Reuters on January 9, 2018 that manufacturing had started the prior month and that customer site surveys had begun. The Q4/FY 2017 shareholder letter likewise placed initial Solar Roof production in Q4, with hiring ahead of schedule and a gradual ramp due to manufacturing and installation complexity. (August 31, 2017 AP coverage marked solar-cell production start at the plant, not Solar Roof tile SOP.)

sources.publisher: Reuters, Tesla says solar roof production has started in Buffalo, January 9, 2018
Electrek, Solar Roof tile production at Gigafactory 2 / customer install process, January 9, 2018

articles.headline: Megafactory Texas nearing completion; Megapack 3 and Megablock SOP planned 2026
articles.body: In Q2 2026 Megafactory Texas was nearing completion with Megapack 3 and Megablock start of production still planned for 2026, per the Q2 2026 Update. Earlier updates described the same Houston-area Megafactory. This is progress toward SOP, not SOP itself.

articles.headline: Tesla Semi volume production planned 2026 at new Nevada factory
articles.body: In Q2 2026 Tesla said Semi remained on track for 2026 production at the new Nevada factory (capacity table: Commissioning). Prior Q1 2026 and Q4/FY 2025 Updates likewise kept 2026 volume production on schedule. Distinct from 2022 early/pilot Semi production.
